story: As a buyer, I want to see the list of available products with their prices so that I can decide what to order.
As a buyer, I want to search for a product by name so that I can quickly find what I need without scrolling the full catalog.
As a buyer, I want to add a product to my cart so that I can purchase it later.
As a buyer, I want to change the quantity of a product already in my cart so that my order matches what I actually need.
As a buyer, I want to remove a product from my cart so that I don't get charged for something I no longer want.
As a buyer belonging to Account A, I want to see the negotiated price for a product so that it differs from the price shown to a buyer in Account B.
As a buyer, I want to submit an order below the approval threshold so that it is confirmed immediately without needing manager sign-off.
As a buyer, I want an order above the approval threshold to be routed to my manager so that it cannot be finalized without their sign-off.
As a buyer, I want to add a bulk quantity of a single product (e.g. 500 units) so that I can place a large order in one line item.
As a buyer, I want to see an order confirmation with the correct total after checkout so that I know my order was placed successfully.
